The post-840k schedule replaces each future 50% subsidy cliff with a recursive 19/20 step every 210,000 blocks, nominally a 5% reduction with integer-floor rounding. This creates frequent but smaller changes in nominal subsidy. It does not guarantee stable hashrate or network security and schedules more RIN than unchanged binary halving.
